title: Generalized Aubry-André formula and continuity of the intersection spectrum of the Almost Mathieu operator
summary: We consider the spectrum of the Almost Mathieu operator (AMO) and show that the moments of the restriction of the Lebesgue measure to the intersection spectrum $\text{Leb}|_{Σ_{α,λ}}$ are polynomials in coupling $λ$ with coefficients that are trigonometric polynomials in frequency $α$. The statement can be considered as a generalization of the Aubry-André formula for the measure of the spectrum of AMO.
